description:
Adds the generator that writes the outcome tables of the inter-frame LDPC decoder from the committed evidence.

## Background

The LDPC batch decoder of `gf2-coding` keeps the float flooding contract of `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md`. Its evidence is committed under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/`: before-after confirmations at one worker and several, the batch-size sweep, the matched confirmation against AFF3CT [Cassagne2019], the exploratory fastest-compatible pilot, the decoder calibration campaign with its holdout confirmation, the peak-memory record and the profile series.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed generator writes `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/tables.md` from the committed receipts, plans, execution logs and records, and the file reproduces byte for byte on a second run.
- [hard] REQ-02: The tables present matched-algorithm results apart from fastest-compatible results, and carry single-frame latency, batch-fill cost, sustained throughput, decoder workspace bytes and peak memory, the batch-size sweep, and the physical-core and SMT cells.
- [hard] REQ-03: Conservative-portable, tuned-portable and native results appear in separate rows, each stochastic figure has its sample count and interval, and each outcome appears as its evaluator records it.
- [hard] REQ-04: The generator verifies each campaign's execution log on the way and stops on a campaign that does not verify.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Generate the outcome tables of the inter-frame decoder
